name: Agent Orchestrator implementation

milestones.title: Architecture and feasibility
milestones.exit_criterion: A single task runs successfully on macOS and Windows.

milestones.title: Single-agent CLI
milestones.exit_criterion: The CLI executes a task without touching the primary checkout.

milestones.title: Persistence and concurrency
milestones.exit_criterion: Two parallel tasks survive recoverable failures without lost changes.

milestones.title: Coordinator and approvals
milestones.exit_criterion: A multi-task objective reaches a reviewed candidate without unapproved merging.

milestones.title: Multi-agent support
milestones.exit_criterion: Each supported agent completes the same conformance workflow on both operating systems.

milestones.title: Tauri desktop UI
milestones.exit_criterion: Closing and reopening the UI preserves running daemon tasks.

milestones.title: Release hardening
milestones.exit_criterion: A clean-machine installation passes all release smoke tests.

tasks.title: Define domain contracts and threat model
tasks.details: Define task contracts, task and session separation, state transitions, trust boundaries and authorization invariants.

tasks.title: Demonstrate a single task on both platforms
tasks.details: Record evidence that one task runs successfully on macOS and Windows.

tasks.title: Implement task lifecycle and local records
tasks.details: Validate and persist contracts, states and execution attempts; keep task completion distinct from process exit.

tasks.title: Implement isolated Git worktree lifecycle
tasks.details: Validate repositories, resolve base commits and create a unique branch and worktree per task without changing the primary checkout.

tasks.title: Implement Codex adapter and process supervision
tasks.details: Launch Codex in the worktree, stream structured progress, capture output and exit status, and support cancellation and process cleanup.

tasks.title: Build the single-task CLI workflow
tasks.details: Implement run, tasks, inspect, cancel, diff and cleanup commands; preserve worktrees for inspection and report actionable errors.

tasks.title: Verify primary checkout isolation and safe cleanup
tasks.details: Exercise dirty repositories, cancellation and worktree retention; never delete uncommitted or unlanded work.

tasks.title: Implement SQLite persistence and migrations
tasks.details: Persist projects, contracts, dependencies, attempts, sessions, workspaces, approvals, verification runs, artifacts and an ordered event journal; use WAL and foreign keys.

tasks.title: Build dependency-aware bounded scheduler
tasks.details: Reject dependency cycles; enforce authorization, global and per-project limits, fair scheduling and exclusive worktree ownership. Default to two workers.

tasks.title: Add bounded retries and execution attempt history
tasks.details: Use backoff and create a separate durable attempt for each retry.

tasks.title: Implement process and workspace reconciliation
tasks.details: Lock the data directory, validate process identity, inspect worktrees and partial deliveries, and classify interrupted tasks before resuming scheduling. Address Windows process trees and macOS process groups.

tasks.title: Test concurrent execution and crash recovery
tasks.details: Inject process and runtime failures with two parallel tasks and verify no changes or audit events are silently lost.

tasks.title: Implement structured coordinator decomposition
tasks.details: Validate coordinator proposals against a schema, assign canonical IDs and validate dependencies and task contracts. Keep lifecycle and authorization in the engine.

tasks.title: Enforce task policies and approval state
tasks.details: Persist explicit approval decisions bound to the exact action, parameters and candidate commit; reject unauthorized policy changes and reapprove changed actions.

tasks.title: Implement independent verification
tasks.details: Verify worktree ownership, candidate commit, protected paths and configured validation commands; retain results and apply an explicit execution trust policy.

tasks.title: Implement report-only and local-review delivery
tasks.details: Require authorization before integration, serialize delivery to a destination, revalidate against current state and retain unsafe-to-delete worktrees.

tasks.title: Verify the reviewed multi-task workflow
tasks.details: Demonstrate dependency execution, independent verification and approval enforcement across restarts without unapproved merging.

tasks.title: Implement Pi RPC adapter
tasks.details: Support persistent JSONL RPC, correlated responses and asynchronous events according to detected capabilities.

tasks.title: Implement Claude Code adapter
tasks.details: Verify installed CLI flags, structured output and permission behavior before integration.

tasks.title: Implement capability detection and agent routing
tasks.details: Expose supported streaming, interactive input, cancellation, resumption, structured output, approvals and model selection without successful no-ops.

tasks.title: Run adapter conformance suite on both platforms
tasks.details: Cover framing, launch, cancellation, errors, unexpected EOF, unsupported features, interruption and approvals for each adapter.

tasks.title: Build daemon and authenticated local IPC
tasks.details: Move reliable scheduling to an on-demand daemon; implement versioned length-prefixed JSON-RPC over Unix sockets and Windows named pipes, authorization and capability negotiation.

tasks.title: Implement reconnectable event stream and clients
tasks.details: Support event subscriptions, sequence-based replay, reconnect and the project, task, session, approval, workspace and delivery methods.

tasks.title: Build project, task and coordinator UI
tasks.details: Provide project selection, agent detection, task submission, board, conversation, live events, cancellation and recovery status.

tasks.title: Build diff review and approval UI
tasks.details: Show the candidate and exact action to be approved, and submit approval decisions through the daemon.

tasks.title: Complete desktop lifecycle and initial packaging
tasks.details: Package the desktop app and verify closing and reopening it does not interrupt daemon-owned work.

tasks.title: Review threat model and dependency security
tasks.details: Audit dependencies and plugins, environment allowlists, untrusted inputs, authorization and protected delivery boundaries.

tasks.title: Implement cross-platform release CI
tasks.details: Run native macOS and Windows tests, dependency audits, signing and release builds.

tasks.title: Harden diagnostics and recovery usability
tasks.details: Make failures and recovery actions observable without leaking credentials or silently discarding work.

tasks.title: Test signed installs and upgrades on clean machines
tasks.details: Run release smoke tests, including installation, upgrade, approvals, cancellation and recovery on macOS and Windows.

priority_description: Dependency depth: 1 is highest; tasks with the same value may run in parallel once their dependencies are done. Priority does not imply readiness.
